report_summary: This strong report traces acknowledged future-question transfer, corrected false signals, circular-source provenance and competing rewrites. It considers the invitation to edit and separates substantive content harm from unmeasured outages or labor. Its followup names missing prompts, tool calls, responses and scoring required for stronger conclusions.

techniques.summary: Configuration content and retrieval recipes show attempts, not applied permissions. impact.summary: Caller-supplied SEC-labelled JSON can create circular verification without proving fabrication. Competing rewrites displaced content; unique bodies are not new information or measured downtime.
